name: programming_audit_events
description: Append-only record of programming changes and assignments, with the acting member and the branches each change concerns.
lifecycle: Inserted in the same transaction as the change it records; never updated or deleted at runtime. Retention follows the company (provisional until PH-13).

columns.Meaning: Kind of subject: playlist, layout, group, program or device.
Playlist, layout, group, program or screen the event concerns; not a foreign key, so events outlive deleted subjects.
Branches the change concerns, for branch-scoped audit reads; empty for company-wide subjects.
columns.Null meaning: Never null; an empty array means the subject is company-wide.

columns.Meaning: Membership through which the change was made.
Event name such as playlist.created, playlist.items_replaced, layout.created, layout.saved, group.span_changed, program.output_replaced, device.assignment_changed or device.left_group_on_move.
Bounded summary: names, counts, versions and IDs; never media content.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is a known principal.
The branch list is present and bounded.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The acting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((subject_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['playlist'::character varying, 'group'::character varying, 'program'::character varying, 'device'::character varying, 'layout'::character varying])::text[])))
constraints.Purpose: Subjects come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programming_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.programming_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX programming_audit_events_subject_idx ON public.programming_audit_events USING btree (company_id, subject_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Reads a subject's history newest first.
